lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the gill slits, primarily concentrated along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a checkered or grid-like appearance where the blobs act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the superior edge and low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, lower-intensity circular blobs located on the posterior-half of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A specific cluster of three high-intensity blobs located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a nearly vertical line.
